• NorthEast United FC vs Sporting Club Delhi || Match Content || Highlights || Match 34 || 24-Nov-2026 || English ||
VAR drama in Imphal! Watch the big moments as NorthEast United FC and Sporting Club Delhi drew 1-1 at the Khuman Lampak Stadium in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Mohammed Aimen struck early for Delhi, and Antonio Moyano equalised from Nikhil Barla's pass before the half-hour mark. NorthEast pushed hard in the second half and finished with 21 shots. Alaaeddine Ajaraie had the ball in the net in the 79th minute, but VAR ruled it out.
